scope: price lossless Comfort input capture against a fully allocation-free path; do not change product sources, build a product, or contact hardware

loss_model.reason: five already-pending events plus one physical event per 50 Hz frame throughout the accepted worst whole-collection pause

capture_shape.event_representation: one raw PETSCII code byte; modifiers are intentionally absent because the Comfort editor consumes only code
capture_shape.producer: owned raster IRQ drains every available ordinary hardware event before returning
capture_shape.consumer: Comfort-only raw scalar poll through existing peek/poke primitives
capture_shape.lifetime: enabled only while Comfort is collecting input; disabled before evaluation, on normal exit, and in native error recovery

acceptance: the sixth event and the entire one-event-per-frame burst survive an 89-frame forced collection; no option passes merely by reducing heap cells
